classification.difficultyReason: Invert a divisor and retain four excluded values through cancellation.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}\frac{3y^2-6y}{(y-2)(y+1)}\div\frac{6y}{3y+6}&=\frac{3y^2-6y}{(y-2)(y+1)}\times\frac{3y+6}{6y}\\\frac{3y^2-6y}{(y-2)(y+1)}\div\frac{6y}{3y+6}&=\frac{3y(y-2)}{(y-2)(y+1)}\times\frac{3(y+2)}{6y}\\\frac{3y^2-6y}{(y-2)(y+1)}\div\frac{6y}{3y+6}&=\frac{3(y+2)}{2(y+1)}\end{align*}$$
Original domain: $y\in\mathbb R\setminus\{-2,-1,0,2\}$. The divisor must be defined and nonzero.
